messages:
jess-cs: quick flag  three trial customers reported degraded embedding relevance and intermittent 502s after the morning runtime deploy. two are in late renewal; need coordinated comms.

otto-eng: investigating. early repro shows memory pressure on decode path with large batches.

mira-sre: opened INC-2026-420; applying temporary throttle to bulk-import queues and diverting heavy jobs to standby nodes. monitoring.

cs-bot: Incident INC-2026-420 | priority: medium-high | status: mitigating | link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-420

jess-cs: CS needs a one-paragraph email: impact, mitigation, ETA window, data safety, and goodwill. short please.

otto-eng: tech blurb: "Cause: memory growth in updated model during large-batch decode. Mitigation: throttling and standby routing; rebuild artifact underway. ETA: 48-72 hours; rollback possible sooner."

carla-legal: wording check: say "we do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration." avoid promising fixes under 24h. Archive outbound comms per retention policy.

jess-cs: draft below, will send to the three contacts after signoff.

jess-cs: ```Hi <Customer Contact>,

We observed reduced embedding relevance and occasional 502 errors for some high-volume bulk-import requests following a runtime update this morning. Our engineers have applied temporary throttling and are validating a rebuilt model artifact. We do not detect any customer data loss or exfiltration. We expect a validated mitigation within 48-72 hours and will update you sooner if we complete the rollback or fix earlier.

As a courtesy, we will apply a one-time account credit to impacted onboarding usage and offer a priority technical review to tune ingest parameters. Reply to reserve a slot.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Support```

mira-sre: portal status line: "throttling applied; artifact rebuild in progress; monitoring success & relevance metrics."

jess-cs: will upload sent emails to cs-incident-archive for retention and loop renewals AE for the two high-risk trials. plan: targeted emails, portal post, credits + review, RCA within 72h.

otto-eng: pushing e2e test for large-batch ingest to prevent regression.

jess-cs: thanks all, sending after portal post. :thumbsup:
